project: HALO Engine: Localized String Rupture on Quantum Hardware
author: Abhiroop Gohar

10_qubit_marrakesh.description: Unmitigated depth-scaling saturation sweep on 10 qubits (Figure 3a, Section IV.A). Sequence of 11 jobs corresponding to increasing Trotter depths.

16_qubit_fez.description: Unmitigated depth-scaling saturation sweep on 16 qubits at t=0.8 (Figure 3b, Section IV.A).

zero_noise_extrapolation.description: ZNE recovery data for the 10-qubit lattice utilizing unitary folding at t=0.5 (Figure 4, Section IV.B). 3 distinct runs corresponding to scale factors lambda = 1, 3, and 5.

string_rupture_temporal_sweep.description: High-resolution trotterized time-evolution tracking the crossover of localized pair creation at t=0.790 (Figure 5, Section V.A).

deep_confinement_g5.description: Quantum quench dynamics of the heavy meson at strong coupling g=5 demonstrating unbroken coherent oscillations (Figure 6, Section V.B).

phase_diagram_g_sweep.description: Parameter sweep of the coupling constant g locked at t=0.8 pinpointing the critical QLM boundary at gc=1.0 (Figure 7, Section V.C).

variational_ground_state_20q.description: Unmitigated execution of the 20-qubit HALO-VQE ansatz demonstrating hardware depolarization collapse (Figure 8, Section VI.A). Full 28-step optimization trajectory.
